'''He Yaling''' ({{zh|c=何雅玲|p=Hé Yǎlíng}}; born September 1963) is a Chinese physicist and professor at [[Xi'an Jiaotong University]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

She was a representative of the [[20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Yi Yi ({{lang|zh|伊一}}) |url=http://district.ce.cn/newarea/sddy/201705/23/t20170523_23125377.shtml |script-title=zh:陕西省选举产生44名党的十九大代表（名单） |work=ce.cn |date=23 May 2017 |access-date=29 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> She was an alternate of the [[19th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party]] and is an alternate of the [[20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party]].<ref>{{cite news |author1=Xu Kun ({{lang|zh|徐锟}}) |url=http://cn.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202210/22/WS63537f11a310817f312f2d1a.html |script-title=zh:中国共产党第二十届中央委员会候补委员名单（171名） |work=Chinadaily |date=22 October 2022 |access-date=29 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref>

==Biography==
He Yaling was born in [[Xi'an]], [[Shaanxi]], in September 1963.<ref name="he">{{cite news |url=http://casad.cas.cn/sourcedb_ad_cas/zw2/ysxx/jskxb/201512/t20151224_4502681.html |script-title=zh:何雅玲 |work=casad.cas.cn |date=2015 |access-date=29 October 2022 |language=zh}}</ref> After graduating from [[Xi'an Jiaotong University]] in 1985, she stayed and taught at the university.<ref name="he"/> She was honored as a Distinguished Young Scholar by the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars in 2004.

==Publications==
* {{cite book |language=zh |script-title=zh:工程热力学常见题型解析及模拟题 |trans-title=Analysis and Simulation of Common Problems in Engineering Thermodynamics |year=2004 |publisher=Northwestern Polytechnical University Press |location=Xi'an, Shaanxi |isbn=9787561217429}}

* {{cite book |language=zh |script-title=zh:工程热力学精要分析典型题解 |trans-title=Typical Problems of Essential Analysis of Engineering Thermodynamics |year=2008 |publisher=Xi'an Jiaotong University Press |location=Xi'an, Shaanxi |isbn=9787560513195}}

* {{cite book |language=zh |script-title=zh:工程热力学精要解析 |trans-title=Essential Analysis of Engineering Thermodynamics |year=2014 |publisher=Xi'an Jiaotong University Press |location=Xi'an, Shaanxi |isbn=9787560567785}}

* {{cite book |language=zh |script-title=zh:储能科学与工程本科专业知识体系与课程设置 |trans-title=Knowledge System and Curriculum for Undergraduate Students of Energy Storage Science and Engineering |year=2021 |publisher=Higher Education Press |location=Beijing |isbn=9787040561425 }}

==Honours and awards==
* 2004 State Natural Science Award (Second Class)
* 2009 State Technological Invention Award (Second Class)
* 2012 State Natural Science Award (Second Class)
* 2015 Science and Technology Progress Award of the [[Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation]]
* October 2015 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
